uncertainty.summary: Simulated reference configuration, not an operational relay: ESA/SSTL Lunar Pathfinder's indicative baseline orbit from the SSTL service guide v2.3 sec. 3.4.3 (a 5740 km, e 0.58, i 54.856°, argp 86.322°, ~10.8 h), planned for 2027 and not in orbit in this window. The guide gives no epoch, frame, RAAN or phase, so all are ASSUMED: epoch 2027-03-01 00:00 UTC, the IAU Moon body frame at that epoch, RAAN 0° and true anomaly 0° there. Where the orbit plane sits and when the satellite passes over the site are therefore illustrative only, and so is the timing of every relay pass and blackout. No published state to check the propagation against. Two-body Kepler propagation (no lunar gravity field or Earth/Sun pull), so positions drift from a real orbit with distance from the epoch; size of the drift unknown. Rotation to Moon-fixed by the IAU 2015 model. seesEarth: the relay → Earth-centre line misses a smooth 1737.4 km Moon (geometry.sees_earth shortcut: no limb terrain, Earth's centre only). Relay positions are geometric, Earth's is Horizons' apparent one (horizons.track shortcut, ~0.006°).
